user.title: MagicbHAnds
user.description: MagicbHAnds for Home Assistant. Sends light and vibration effects to MagicBand+ bands through your MagicBand bridges (the Send MagicBand effect action), and runs your MagicBand readers: it logs every band tapped, lets you give bands to people (Home Assistant users or not) and keeps each reader's allowed list in sync.

assign_band.title: Add or assign a band
assign_band.description: Tap the band on a reader first, then choose it here (most recent first) and who it belongs to. Bands belonging to an allowed person get the welcome on every reader.

data_description.label: For example 'blue MagicBand+'. Useful when someone has several bands.

new_person.title: New person
new_person.description: People don't need to be Home Assistant users. Link one only if you want automations to know which HA person tapped in.

remove_person.title: Remove a person
remove_person.description: Their bands are kept but become unassigned, so they'll be denied.

remove_band.title: Remove a band
remove_band.description: Forget a band completely. If it's tapped again it shows up as new.

link_bluetooth.title: Link a band's Bluetooth
link_bluetooth.description:
Each MagicBand+ sends a Bluetooth beacon about every 15 minutes, which is how Home Assistant knows it's nearby. Choose the beacon (a Bluetooth band) and which band or person it belongs to.

Not sure which is which? Put one band in a metal tin (or out of range) for half an hour: the one still showing *nearby* is the other. Tapping a band on a reader links it automatically when only one unlinked band is heard.

data_description.owner: Linking to a band's NFC ID gives it that band's owner. Or give it to a person directly, until the band has been tapped on a reader.

data_description.show_in_sidebar: The management page: bands, people, readers and bridges. Turn it off if you show the page somewhere else, such as in your own set of dashboards.
data_description.battery_reminder_level: When a MagicBand+ battery drops to this level, it shows in Repairs and the magicband_battery_low event fires (the "Charge me" blueprint turns that into a phone notification). 0 turns reminders off.
data_description.snapshot_days: Pictures from readers' cameras (if you've linked one) are deleted after this many days.

error.name_taken: There's already a person with that name.
error.invalid_band: That isn't a valid band ID (4, 7 or 10 bytes of hex), so it can't be given to anyone. Remove it instead.

abort.no_bands: No bands yet. Tap a band on a MagicBand reader first.
abort.no_people: No people yet. Add one first.
abort.no_bluetooth_bands: No MagicBand+ has been heard over Bluetooth yet. Its beacon comes about every 15 minutes: check back later.
abort.invalid_band: That isn't a valid band ID (4, 7 or 10 bytes of hex), so it can't be given to anyone. The person was added; remove the band instead.

on_seconds.description: Seconds the band stays lit (0 = default).

always_on.description: Stay lit until the next command or 'off'.

duration_ms.description: How long each bridge broadcasts, in ms (0 = default 2 s).

seconds.description: Seconds to send the fast-mode ping for, for the wake effect (default 15).

list_bridges.name: List MagicBand bridges
list_bridges.description: Return the Command entities of every MagicBand bridge.

list_heard.name: List Bluetooth heard
list_heard.description: Return recent MagicBand+ Bluetooth traffic heard by Home Assistant's Bluetooth adapters and proxies. "heard" is the last 30 messages of any kind (mostly your bridges' own commands); "bands" keeps the last 200 band messages, so commands can't push them out. Each has the device address, signal strength, which proxy heard it and how long after the last send.

list_bluetooth_bands.name: List Bluetooth bands
list_bluetooth_bands.description: Every MagicBand+ recognised from its Bluetooth beacon: owner, linked NFC band, nearby, battery, signal by adapter, the level byte's history, which bits change, and the last 50 raw beacons. Also the encrypted messages heard and any pairing in progress.

link_bluetooth.name: Link Bluetooth band
link_bluetooth.description: Link a MagicBand+'s Bluetooth beacon to its NFC band (it then belongs to that band's owner), or give it to a person.

set_band_access.name: Set band access
set_band_access.description: When a band works: a daily time window, days of the week and an expiry. Admins only.

from.name: From
from.description: Start of the daily window (local time).

until.name: Until
until.description: End of the daily window; earlier than From means overnight.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days the window applies to (empty: every day).

expires.name: Expires
expires.description: The band stops working from this date and time.

clear.name: Clear
clear.description: Remove every limit: the band works whenever its owner is allowed.

enrol.name: Enrol bands
enrol.description: For the next few minutes, every band tapped that nobody owns is given to this person. Admins only.

label.name: Nickname
label.description: Optional; each band gets it with a number ("Nana's band 1").

device_id.name: Reader
device_id.description: Only bands tapped on this reader are enrolled (recommended: the one you're standing at). Leave empty for any reader.

history.name: Tap history
history.description: Returns the most recent taps, newest first. Admins only.

answer.name: Answer a reader
answer.description: In the reader's "Ask Home Assistant" mode, welcome or deny the band just tapped (within 3 seconds of the tap). Administrators and automations only.

device_id.name: Reader
device_id.description: The reader that's waiting for an answer.

unpair_reader.name: Unpair a reader
unpair_reader.description: Release a reader from this Home Assistant's key, for example before moving it to another Home Assistant. This Home Assistant then leaves it alone (no allowed list, no pairing) until you take it back with Take back a reader. Administrators only.

pair_reader.name: Take back a reader
pair_reader.description: Manage a reader released with Unpair a reader again: it pairs with this Home Assistant (tap a band on it to confirm). Administrators only.

set_reader_camera.name: Set a reader's camera
set_reader_camera.description: Optional: take a picture from this camera with every tap on the reader, kept with the tap in the history (admins only). Leave the camera empty to stop.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: The camera that sees the reader. Empty: no pictures.

reader_sync_failed.title: {reader} didn't take the allowed list
reader_sync_failed.description:
Home Assistant got: {error}

If that's a timeout or no reply, the reader may still have applied the list; it's sent again every few minutes and this goes away once the reader confirms it. If the reader refused the list, it keeps none until it gets one it can apply, so it denies every band on its own (Home Assistant's own decisions are unaffected): if the list is too long, give fewer people access; otherwise restart the reader or update its firmware.

list_too_long.title: Too many allowed bands for the readers
list_too_long.description: {bands} bands are allowed, but a reader holds about {capacity}. Readers that can't store the whole list deny every band on their own until there are fewer allowed bands.

reader_offline.title: {reader} is offline
reader_offline.description: Home Assistant hasn't been able to reach this MagicBand reader since {since}. It keeps welcoming bands from its last allowed list, but changes (such as a band you've revoked) don't reach it until it's back. Check its power and Wi-Fi.

battery_low.title: {band} needs charging
battery_low.description: Its battery is at {battery}%. This clears itself once the band has been charged. Set the reminder level under MagicbHAnds → Configure → Settings.

reader_pairing.title: Tap a band on {reader} to pair it
reader_pairing.description:
MagicbHAnds is pairing with {reader} for the first time. So that no one else can claim it, a reader only finishes pairing when someone taps a band (any band) on it: the ring breathes blue while it waits, for up to 2 minutes, and turns green when paired. That tap does nothing else. If the ring isn't blue, press Sync (or wait a few minutes) and tap then.

If Repairs says another pairing request is waiting instead, don't tap: someone else asked first. Wait 2 minutes and sync again.
